name: petal-and-rose
description: Petal & Rose — premium beauty & skincare e-commerce

scripts.postinstall: cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.dev:lan: concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev:lan --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix client && npm run build --prefix server
